patch.value: Adopt --respect-item-release so release attribution matches the rest of the fleet

pm-brief was the only fleet package left out of the fleet-wide --respect-item-release rollout, and its pm-changelog devDependency was still pinned at 2026.7.18. Without the flag, single-window generation ignores an item's release field, so closing a tracker whose fix shipped in an earlier release injects that work into the current window.

all four pm-changelog invocations in package.json pass --respect-item-release; the pm-changelog devDependency matches the fleet at ^2026.7.24; changelog:check passes with the flag in place; generated CHANGELOG.md output is unchanged

value.author: unknown
value.text: Verified the output is unchanged: with the flag added, changelog:check reports the CHANGELOG is already up to date, so this is a behaviour-preserving adoption for the current item set and only takes effect once an item carries a release field.

patch.value: All four invocations carry --respect-item-release, devDependency bumped to ^2026.7.24, changelog:check green with output unchanged.
